g.desc: V17 | Agreement, output length and controlled priority
Exposed authored response bank: 309 tasks, 204 components, 22,794 ordered pairs; no new model predictions
Exact score: all 22,794 pairs tie in both contrasts.
The 2 common-priority losses are ordered-pair records.
Intersection and matched random have identical length per pair.
They are not 2 independent natural failures.
Other fixed-count controls share min(3, union size).
The four-candidate gold oracle excludes the negative control. Cross-fit is exposed-data development, not an independent final.
Primary and post-primary plans remain separate. ID-count matching is not token/call-cost matching.
